decisions.title: Implemented: durable WhatsApp jobs; uncertain sends pause for review, not blind replay

Unknown sends never replay; missing/future/expired timestamps fail closed. Real recipient/device acceptance, approved template fallback and retention policy remain gates.

decisions.detail: Use bounded specialists with exclusive shared-file ownership in the existing isolated cloud checkout. Do not create worktrees unless explicitly requested. Centrally reserve migrations/shared contracts and integrate meaningful tests. Do not contact vendors, approve legal terms, activate billing or claim blocked acceptance complete. Update portable context and truthful issue evidence after delivery slices.
